secrets: throw-away values only; passed as RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE (0600), AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY env, ssh key via -o sftp.args=-F<0600 ssh_config>; nothing secret on argv
source: /src: Movies/Nosferatu (1922)/Nosferatu.mkv (3000000 B) hard-linked as TV/Show/Season 01/hardlink-of-nosferatu.mkv, S01E01.srt, changing.txt (v1, v2, v3), empty dir
notes: --json: progress/summary on stdout (one JSON object per line); errors and exit_error on stderr as JSON, but stderr can also carry plain text (retry lines, '\u001b[2Ksignal ... received, cleaning up'); parse line by line and skip non-JSON
status lines omit seconds_elapsed/seconds_remaining/error_count/current_files when zero or empty
bytes_done counts bytes read by the archiver, not uploaded: percent_done hits 1 before the upload finishes when --limit-upload throttles
hard links: counted twice in total_bytes, stored once (data_added ~ one copy)
prune has no JSON output in 0.18.1: prune --json prints text (prune-json-flag.txt); use the exit code
forget: --keep-last 0 == no policy (exit 1); every policy with n>=1 keeps the newest snapshot of each group; --keep-within is relative to the newest snapshot, not now

repo-missing.stderr.jsonl.cmd: restic cat config --json (bucket exists, no repo)

s3-bad-credentials-retrying.stderr.txt.cmd: restic cat config --json with a wrong AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, killed by timeout 40
s3-bad-credentials-retrying.stderr.txt.exit: 1 after SIGTERM; restic itself retries for minutes (same for a missing bucket)

wrong-password.stderr.jsonl.cmd: restic snapshots --json with a wrong password file

empty-password.stderr.jsonl.cmd: restic cat config --json without any password source

locked.stderr.jsonl.cmd: restic prune --json while a backup holds a lock

locked-stale-retry-lock.stderr.jsonl.cmd: restic forget --retry-lock 5s with a stale lock left by kill -9 (same host, dead PID)

lock.json.cmd: restic cat lock <id> (lock left by kill -9)

backup-dry-run.jsonl.cmd: restic backup --json --dry-run -v ... (summary has dry_run:true and a snapshot_id that is not saved)

backup-partial.jsonl.cmd: restic backup --json /src2 as nobody with one unreadable file (stdout)

backup-partial.stderr.jsonl.cmd: same (stderr: error + exit_error); the snapshot IS saved

backup-after-kill.jsonl.cmd: re-run of the killed backup: data_added = full size (no reuse of the orphaned packs)

forget-keep-within-1d-dry-run.json.cmd: restic forget --json --tag ret --group-by host,tags --keep-within 1d --dry-run (newest is 2 days old: still kept)

sftp-no-ssh-binary.stderr.jsonl.cmd: restic -r sftp:... init --json in bunkarr:dev (no ssh client installed)

rclone-backend-hostkey-mismatch.stderr.t.cmd: restic -r rclone:bksftp:... snapshots --json with a known_hosts that lacks the negotiated key type
